focus.name: interaction-spawn-response-family-static-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the six-handler response-spawn block to stable creation identities while retaining selector-qualified historical names.

handlers.name: InteractionSpawn_CreateType2FWithFacing_29
handlers.post_spawn: set actor facing byte at offset 0x09

contracts: Selectors 0x23/0x24 and 0x25 create the two Type-0x05 interaction variants through LevelObjectSpawnEntry and refresh palette resource 0x001292B2 when the palette-update gate is clear.
Selector 0x46 forward-spawns Type-0x03; selector 0x18 reverse-spawns Type-0x10 and queues prepared audio command 0x32 when its audio gate is active.
Selectors 0x2A and 0x29 reverse-spawn the Type-0x2F template, with selector 0x29 additionally publishing the actor facing byte at offset 0x09.
evidence: Exact 68000 handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Direct template loads, allocator calls, palette/audio side effects, and facing-byte write
limitations: The names identify runtime actor types and exact response-spawn contracts, not user-facing object or scene roles.
The upstream lifecycle of palette and audio gates remains unresolved.
